children: Change Agents completed Phase 2 of its Catch-Up agentic AI video platform and received $125,000 in AWS project funding.
Completed Phase 2 development of the Catch-Up agentic AI video studio platform led by Caylent.
AWS provided $125,000 in funding tied to successful project completion within the agreed timeline.
Beta testing of the enhanced platform is expected to begin in September 2026 to evaluate performance and scalability.
Platform aims to autonomously generate personalized short-form videos for podcasters and social media creators, supporting a SaaS commercialization path.
